description_en: A rigid rectangular woven body with hinged metal mouth frame, two short cane handles and leather corner guards. Canonical front: a central unmarked metal clasp above the woven wall. Side view: a deep triangular gusset beneath the open-mouth hinge. Rear view: an uninterrupted woven wall with two handle anchors. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
